overview_description.description: 36.6 Healthcare Solutions created a software solution designed to create more active engagement between health service providers and their patients which is a critical link in the chain of their healing process. The name came from 36.60 is the ideal body temperature! 36.6 will keep “doctors” closer to their patients’ status and allows them to make an accurate real-time decision; that is at the right time and in the right way.
